objective: Preregister 18 candidates for T-20260929-02: pre-holiday return premium (Ariel 1990 lineage, Ko & Yang 2021 small-firm-only out-of-sample replication). 12 primary PREHOL_{IWM,IJR,IWC,VB,SPY,QQQ}_H{1,2} candidates (4 small/micro-cap target tickers, 2 large-cap control tickers, hold 1 or 2 sessions) plus 6 PREHOL_{ticker}_RAND per-ticker frequency-matched random-day placebos, for scripts/screen_batch.py --batch h20260929_02_pre_holiday_etf --iteration h20260929_02_pre_holiday_etf. No return, Sharpe or backtest number is computed in this dossier.

data.data_v1_sip_daily: IWM/IJR/IWC/VB/SPY/QQQ/SHY daily bars, data/sip/daily/*/*.parquet (local SIP archive, no new fetch).

features.feature_v1_trading_calendar_gap_only: A session d0 is a pre-holiday day iff the calendar-day gap to the next trading session d1 exceeds the weekend-only gap implied by d0's weekday (3 days after a Friday, 1 day otherwise); this reads only close.index, never a price value (see h20260928_42_opex_week.py's identical convention and justification for its own 3rd-Friday calendar anchor). The RAND placebo reads only close.columns/close.index plus a SHA-256 hash of ticker+date -- also never a price value.

labels.label_v1_close_signal_next_open_fill: Entry signal fires at the close of the session immediately before the pre-holiday day -> buy at the pre-holiday day's open. Exit signal fires at the close of the hold-th held session -> sell at the next session's open, back to SHY. Frozen project contract.

validation.validation_v1_screen_lane_frozen_windows: screen_lane.py frozen select 2023-09-18..2025-12-31 / anchor 2024-01-08..2026-09-17 / holdout 2026-01-02..2026-09-17 (contaminated) / stress 2016-05-02..2023-09-15 windows, D freq (single version, no offset sweep -- a calendar-event rule has no rebalance-day choice) for all 18 candidates.

costs.cost_v1_10_20bps_next_open: 10bp per side primary, 20bp per side stress, screen_lane.py COST_BPS_PRIMARY/STRESS.

benchmarks.benchmark_v1_prehol_vs_s3_k1_k2: K1 (net-10bp anchor Sharpe>=1.1882 and stress Sharpe>=0.6447, positive 20bp CAGR both windows) / K2 (63-session inverse-vol blend with S3 beats a vol-matched S3+SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe both windows) / strong_keep (K2 edge>=0.10, or K1 Sharpe in both windows >= S3's own 1.4853/0.8059) / watch_recent (anchor Sharpe>=1.1882, stress unmet), per this manifest's keep_rule. Only the 12 primary candidates are keep-eligible. Small-cap-vs-large-cap median judged Sharpe difference is reported, not a gate.

trial_count_and_dsr_note: 18 candidates total (12 primary + 6 RAND placebos) in this iteration's own screen_batch.py run; n_trials=18 is what leaderboard.json/results.json report automatically (screen_lane.py's own convention, same as h20260929_01's 15=12+3 and h20260929_10's 12=10+2). report.md additionally reports a manual 12-candidate-only DSR (excluding the 6 placebos) using open_composer.research.campaign_statistics.deflated_sharpe_probability directly, for comparison.

keep_rule.K1: net-10bp Sharpe (D freq, single version -- no offset sweep) >= 1.1882 in the anchor window AND >= 0.6447 in the stress window, with positive CAGR at 20bp per side in both windows. Only the 12 primary (PREHOL_*_H1/H2) candidates are eligible.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH the anchor and stress windows. Only the 12 primary candidates are eligible.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window Sharpe >= 1.1882 (K1's anchor bar) but the stress window does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only, not a keep. Only primary candidates are eligible.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.4853 anchor / 0.8059 stress, exact figures from h20260928_01_s3_rebalance_tranching/results.json).
keep_rule.pass_requires: K1 OR K2, for a primary (PREHOL_*) candidate only.
keep_rule.placebo_internal_falsification: If a primary candidate would otherwise be kept (K1, K2, strong_keep, or watch_recent), but its own ticker's PREHOL_{ticker}_RAND placebo has a judged anchor-window Sharpe >= that primary candidate's own judged anchor Sharpe, the primary candidate is demoted to 'not kept (placebo replication)'. PREHOL_*_RAND candidates are NEVER eligible for K1/K2/strong_keep/watch_recent regardless of their own Sharpe.
keep_rule.small_cap_vs_large_cap_report_only: median judged Sharpe across {PREHOL_IWM_H1, PREHOL_IWM_H2, PREHOL_IJR_H1, PREHOL_IJR_H2, PREHOL_IWC_H1, PREHOL_IWC_H2, PREHOL_VB_H1, PREHOL_VB_H2} minus median judged Sharpe across {PREHOL_SPY_H1, PREHOL_SPY_H2, PREHOL_QQQ_H1, PREHOL_QQQ_H2}, both windows, reported in report.md -- not a keep/not-keep gate, tests whether Ko & Yang (2021)'s own small-firm-only out-of-sample pattern reproduces locally.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: This iteration's own leaderboard.json/results.json report n_trials=18 (12 primary + 6 placebos), computed automatically by scripts/screen_batch.py. A manual 12-candidate-only DSR is additionally computed and reported in report.md for comparison.
